status.description: This is the current status of the test suite run.

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the test suite run.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the organization this run belongs to.

testSuiteId.description: This is the unique identifier for the test suite this run belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the test suite run was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the test suite run was last updated.

testResults.description: These are the results of the tests in this test suite run.

name.description: This is the name of the test suite run.
